signals.signal: OTP Group's 1Q 2026 report gives DSK Group's network at 31/03/2026: 273 branches, 958 ATMs, 22,641 POS terminals, 5,355 closing FTE - versus 274 branches / 955 ATMs / 20,994 POS / 5,319 FTE at 31/12/2025. The POS estate grew by 1,647 terminals (+7.8%) in one quarter.
signals.source_name: OTP Bank Plc. Summary of the first quarter 2026 results (Staff level and other information table, p.39)
signals.implies: The ATM fleet is essentially flat (+3 q/q) while merchant acquiring expands fast - spend will go to refresh/recycler conversion rather than fleet growth, plus POS hardware and managed services.
signals.likelihood: High that the ATM fleet stays c.950-960 through 2026
signals.followup: Track the same table in OTP's 2Q 2026 report (due Aug-2026); establish whether the POS jump is organic acquiring or a portfolio transfer.

signals.signal: DSK's own live branch/ATM locator feed (dskbank.bg/GetOfficesData, pulled 30/07/2026) returns 817 locations: 726 with an ATM (441 ATM-only sites, 285 branch+ATM) and 376 with a branch. Only 212 locations carry the 'Cash deposit' flag - c.29% of DSK ATM locations - leaving c.514 cash-out-only ATM sites. 192 locations have a 24h banking zone, 127 are open 24 hours, and just 3 are flagged 'Cashless office'.
signals.source_name: DSK Bank branch/ATM locator data feed (dskbank.bg/GetOfficesData?cultureName=en, linked from the Branch network page)
signals.implies: This is the hard quantification of the recycler white space: roughly seven in ten DSK ATM sites are still dispense-only. Direct target for cash recyclers/CDMs plus cash-cycle managed services. Only 3 cashless offices means the in-branch teller-cash-recycler (TCR) opportunity is essentially untouched.
signals.likelihood: Medium-High that DSK expands deposit-capable ATMs during 2026-27 as euro cash habits settle
signals.followup: Re-pull the feed quarterly to trend the 'Cash deposit' count; ask DSK cash management what deposit-ATM penetration they are targeting.

signals.signal: DSK moved its cash-in ATMs to euro in a phased cut-over: BGN accepted to 31/01/2026, phased euro acceptance from 01/02/2026, both currencies fee-free 01-06/02/2026, and from 07/02/2026 all deposit ATMs accept euro only (denominations 5, 10, 20, 50, 100). Capacity is 40-150 notes per transaction 'depending on the ATM model'; devices carried stickers showing which currency each accepted during the switch.
signals.source_name: DSK Bank news release (BG): 'От 1 февруари депозитните банкомати на Банка ДСК поетапно започват да приемат евро'
signals.implies: The 40-vs-150-note spread proves at least two generations/OEM families of note acceptor in the deposit fleet - a mixed estate ripe for standardisation on modern recyclers, with validator/cassette and firmware work attached.
signals.followup: Map which sites take 150 notes vs 40 - that separates newest from oldest hardware and, by capacity signature, points at the OEM families.

signals.signal: DSK's FY2025 audited statements show 2025 additions of BGN 34,664k to intangibles (separate; BGN 36,720k consolidated - software/licences plus assets in the course of acquisition) and BGN 39,355k additions to property, plant and equipment, with IT-equipment net book value rising from BGN 40,566k to BGN 63,211k (+55.8%) - roughly BGN 74m (c.EUR 37.8m) of combined 2025 technology/hardware capex. At 31/12/2024 the network comprised 5 regional centres, 51 financial centres, 23 business centres/zones, 85 branches and 109 bank offices.
signals.source_name: DSK Bank AD Separate and Consolidated Financial Statements 2025, Notes 33-34 and general information
signals.implies: The 56% jump in IT-equipment NBV is consistent with a hardware refresh wave around the euro changeover - a live, sizeable budget line for self-service hardware, security and managed services.
signals.likelihood: High that elevated hardware capex continues into 2026
signals.followup: Compare against the 1H-2026 statements when published; ask what share of IT-equipment additions was self-service hardware.

signals.signal: CEO Tamas Hak-Kovacs stated DSK invests over EUR 250m a year in maintaining and developing its infrastructure and over EUR 25m (over BGN 50m in the Bulgarian-language version) in new assets - software, hardware, office modernisation and the deployment of new ATMs.
signals.source_name: Economic.bg interview: 'The financial peace of mind of Bulgarians is DSK Bank's mission'
signals.implies: A publicly stated annual new-asset budget that explicitly names new ATMs - the anchor number for sizing an ATM/recycler and managed-services proposal.
signals.likelihood: High that a comparable envelope repeats in 2026
signals.followup: Seek a 2026 restatement of the EUR 25m new-asset figure and its ATM split.

signals.signal: DSK reports that nearly 70% of its new clients now start the relationship entirely digitally. In DSK Mobile's first year (launched Jun-2025): 800,000+ users, 69,000+ accounts opened online in-app, 70,000+ loans issued fully digitally, 94,000+ users digitally enrolled in banking plans, 16.5m transfers, a record c.20,000 new users in a single day, and account opening in under 5 minutes.
signals.source_name: DSK Bank news release (BG): 'Близо 70% от новите клиенти на Банка ДСК започват отношенията си с банката изцяло дигитално'
signals.implies: Remote onboarding at scale drives demand for eKYC/identity verification, liveness and document checks and AML screening throughput - and it accelerates the branch shift to advisory, the trigger for TCRs and in-branch self-service.
signals.followup: Identify DSK's eKYC/video-identification provider and whether onboarding is built in-house or licensed.

signals.signal: DSK launched Bulgaria's first fully generative-AI customer assistant on 14/07/2025, built on OpenAI models trained on DSK product context, average response under 10 seconds, live on dskbank.bg and dskdirect.bg; a new AI-powered site search went live 20/07/2026; and the assistant is being embedded in DSK Mobile for client-context personalised advice during 2026. Euromoney named DSK 'Best bank for retail banking in Bulgaria' 2026, citing accelerated digitalisation and new AI services.
signals.source_name: Investor.bg / DSK Bank press release; DSK news listing item of 20/07/2026
signals.implies: An AI-forward buyer with a strong in-house build bias - realistic openings are AI-assisted transaction monitoring, AML alert triage and extending the assistant into self-service/ATM journeys, not off-the-shelf chatbots.
signals.followup: Confirm the DSK Mobile in-app AI go-live date and whether any AI delivery is outsourced.

signals.signal: In a 01/11/2025 interview, MB member and Executive Director Retail Slaveyko Slaveykov said DSK runs an in-house development team of 100+ specialists with c.10 teams working solely on DSK Mobile, has over 1 million digital-banking clients (more than half its base), holds c.70% of Bulgaria's registered Blink instant-P2P users, ships new functionality monthly, and is moving branches to a consultative role for complex products while day-to-day operations go fully digital. A new international share-trading platform launches in 2026.
signals.source_name: Capital.bg / DSK Bank media centre interview: 'Банка ДСК - от традиционен модел към финансово-технологична компания'
signals.implies: The in-house bias caps application-software sales, but the branch-to-advisory shift is precisely the trigger for teller cash recyclers and in-branch self-service - Printec's core cash-automation play.
signals.likelihood: Medium-High that branch cash automation follows the advisory-branch shift
signals.followup: Watch for a DSK 'branch of the future' / cashless-branch programme; the live locator shows only 3 cashless offices today.

signals.signal: Visa became DSK's exclusive card-issuing partner under a strategic partnership announced 25-26/03/2025; every card DSK has issued is being replaced with a Visa card by the end of 2026, across a base of 2.0m+ active cards and 2.5-2.6m clients, with Visa tokenisation and AI-based fraud detection cited.
signals.source_name: DSK Bank press release: 'Visa става ексклузивен партньор на Банка ДСК за издаване на карти в рамките на ново стратегическо партньорство'
signals.implies: A full portfolio reissue by 31/12/2026 forces scheme re-certification across the ATM and POS estates, card personalisation/fulfilment volume, HSM key-management work and tokenisation - all Printec-adjacent.
signals.likelihood: High - the end-2026 deadline is the bank's own
signals.followup: Check who performs DSK's card personalisation and whether ATM/POS EMV re-certification is outsourced.

signals.signal: DSK disclosed a personal-data breach on 09/06/2026: paper archives from the 2006-2018 period at its Lukovit office were mishandled, affecting 475 individuals, caused by non-compliance with archiving and destruction procedures. No IT systems were compromised. The Commission for Personal Data Protection (KZLD) was notified and is investigating; DSK opened a lookup portal for affected clients.
signals.source_name: DSK Bank notice: 'Информация за клиенти на Банка ДСК във връзка с нарушение на сигурността на лични данни'
signals.implies: An open regulator investigation raises board attention on records management and data-security controls - an opening for secure document/records digitisation and for security and compliance managed services.
signals.likelihood: Medium that remediation spend follows the KZLD outcome
signals.followup: Track the KZLD decision and any fine or corrective order.

signals.signal: BNB payment statistics show Bulgaria had 5,031 ATM terminals at end-H2 2025 (from 5,087 at end-2024 and 5,128 at end-H2 2023) while POS terminals jumped to 210,861 (from 163,190). In H2 2025 there were 60.7m ATM cash withdrawals worth EUR 13.7bn against only 5.8m ATM cash deposits worth EUR 3.7bn - deposit transactions are under 10% of withdrawal transactions.
signals.source_name: Bulgarian National Bank - Main indicators from the payment statistics for Bulgaria, semi-annual, EUR series (ps_mainindicators_new_eur_bg.xlsx)
signals.implies: A shrinking national ATM base with a very low deposit share confirms the market-wide cash-in/recycler gap; DSK alone is 958 of 5,031 ATMs (19%). Recyclers cut cash-in-transit cost per site, which is the commercial argument in a shrinking-fleet market.
signals.likelihood: High that the national fleet keeps shrinking while deposit functionality grows
signals.followup: Re-pull once BNB publishes H1-2026, the first post-euro half, to measure the euro effect on ATM deposits.

signals.signal: DSK became the largest bank in Bulgaria by assets in 1Q 2026 with EUR 23.49bn, displacing UBB; sector assets rose c.EUR 3bn in the quarter to EUR 119.5bn. DSK also reported a record month for consumer lending in March 2026 (+31% y/y in new consumer loans; average consumer-loan size +15% y/y in 1Q 2026). OTP reported DSK Group 1Q 2026 profit after tax of HUF 43.8bn and 19% ROE, with the reserve ratio falling from 12% to 1% on euro-area entry.
signals.source_name: Capital.bg 'Нов лидер и още печалби за банките'; DSK news release on record consumer lending; OTP 1Q 2026 report
signals.implies: Market leadership plus a large liquidity release from the reserve-ratio cut means the balance sheet can fund a technology and self-service refresh without capital strain.
signals.followup: Confirm against BNB banking-supervision statistics for 30/06/2026 when published.

signals.signal: On 20/07/2026 OTP Bank signed an agreement with Blackstone-managed funds and DNB Bank to acquire Luminor, the third-largest Baltic banking group (total assets EUR 15.9bn; 2025 profit after tax EUR 158m). It is OTP's largest deal to date, lifting group assets by more than 10% and taking OTP to 14 countries, with roughly half of operations inside the euro area. Completion is subject to regulatory approvals.
signals.source_name: OTP Group press release: 'OTP Bank to acquire Luminor, opening a new chapter in Baltic financial markets'
signals.implies: A large integration will absorb group IT and change capacity into 2027-28, which can slow discretionary subsidiary programmes - but it also opens a new 3-country footprint where group-standard self-service and cash-automation vendors get re-decided.
signals.likelihood: Medium that DSK's discretionary IT roadmap is affected; High that group vendor standards get revisited
signals.followup: Watch for the closing date and any group-level vendor consolidation announcements.

coverage_notes: Fresh run (no checkpoint existed). Angles used this run, deliberately varied from previous passes: (1) OTP Group IR primary documents - the 1Q 2026 report's 'Staff level and other information' table gave the first hard 31/03/2026 network numbers (273 branches / 958 ATMs / 22,641 POS / 5,355 FTE), superseding the baseline's ~955-958 ATM / 273-274 branch range; (2) DSK's own audited FY2025 separate + consolidated financial statements, extracted locally with pdfminer, for capex (PPE and intangible movement notes) - a source the baseline had not opened; (3) a NEW source environment: DSK's live branch/ATM locator JSON feed (GetOfficesData), which is the first device-level-ish quantification of the recycler white space (212 of 726 ATM locations flagged 'Cash deposit', only 3 cashless offices); (4) the BNB payment-statistics XLSX (EUR series) downloaded with a desktop User-Agent for market ATM/deposit context; (5) the full DSK Bulgarian news feed for 2026, which surfaced the 30/07/2026 digital-onboarding release, the 09/06/2026 data-breach notice, the 20/07/2026 AI site search and the Luminor deal; (6) BORICA's euro-cutover material for market context. Baseline items re-verified: the ~955-958 ATM / 273-274 branch figures are confirmed and now dated precisely; the euro-only deposit-ATM date is confirmed as 07/02/2026 with the 01-06/02 dual-currency window; DSK as #1 by assets is confirmed at EUR 23.49bn. NEW vs baseline: 1Q-2026 POS +1,647 q/q; the 212-of-726 cash-deposit-location split; FY2025 capex figures; the Visa exclusive-issuer reissue deadline of end-2026; the digital-onboarding 70% and DSK Mobile year-one metrics; the KZLD data-breach investigation; the AI site search; the Luminor acquisition. GENUINE GAP - the ATM FLEET OEM at DSK remains UNIDENTIFIED. Routes tried and exhausted this run: Bulgarian- and English-language searches pairing 'Банка ДСК'/'DSK Bank' with NCR/NCR Atleos, Diebold Nixdorf, Wincor Nixdorf ProCash, CINEO, SelfServ, Opteva; ATM software brands (Vynamic, APTRA, Kalignite); local integrators (Kontrax, Stemo, Datecs, Printec, Payten); DSK's own euro-transition releases and ATM instructions; OTP Group IR documents; and vendor press rooms. The only hardware fingerprint found is DSK's own statement that deposit ATMs take 40-150 notes per transaction 'depending on the ATM model', which establishes at least two acceptor generations but names no vendor. Kontrax's public DSK case study is print/MFP (2,200+ Kyocera devices across 362 offices), not self-service. Note also that DSK's earlier statement of only ~19 cash-deposit ATMs (Jan-2024) is now clearly superseded by 212 cash-deposit locations on the live feed - the baseline's white-space framing holds directionally but the size of the gap is smaller than previously assumed.
access_issues: dnevnik.bg PR article of 20/07/2026 (Euromoney retail-bank award) returned HTTP 403 to WebFetch - the same content was obtained from the DSK news listing and search summaries instead; banker.bg 'Banking Today 2026' article (27/03/2026) returned HTTP 403 to WebFetch and was not substituted. The DSK press release URL for the 14/07/2025 AI assistant returned 404 on direct fetch (percent-encoded Cyrillic path); Investor.bg's coverage of the same release was used and is cited as press-tier. OTP's Integrated Annual Report 2025 (16MB PDF, 260417_Integrated_report_e_final_064.pdf) downloaded successfully but local pdfminer text extraction did not finish inside the run window - it is not cited and nothing from it is claimed.
operator_requests: Two items an operator could add value on: (1) OTP Bank Plc. Integrated Annual Report 2025 (https://www.otpgroup.info/static/sw/file/260417_Integrated_report_e_final_064.pdf) - a large PDF that timed out on local extraction here; worth checking its supplier/procurement and digital-channel sections for any named self-service vendor at DSK. (2) The ATM fleet OEM at DSK is still unnamed after an exhaustive open-web pass - the practical route now is a physical check: photograph the fascia/badging of a DSK deposit ATM (one 150-note site and one 40-note site) or ask the Printec Bulgaria field team, since no public document discloses it.
